SELECT count(*)::int AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE metadata_json ? 'handlerPhases')::int AS with_phases, (100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE (metadata_json->'handlerPhases'->>'elapsedMs')::numeric > 0 AND (metadata_json->'handlerPhases'->>'attributedMs')::numeric >= 0.9 * (metadata_json->'handlerPhases'->>'elapsedMs')::numeric) / nullif(count(*), 0))::float8 AS pct_with_phases FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND tool_name = 'coord:orient' AND invoked_at > now() - interval '24 hours'

WITH a AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.calls),0) c,coalesce(sum(p.total_exec_time),0) t,coalesce(sum(p.wal_bytes),0) w,max(i.stats_reset) reset,max(i.dealloc) dealloc,clock_timestamp() at FROM pg_stat_statements p CROSS JOIN pg_stat_statements_info i WHERE p.toplevel),pause AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT pg_sleep(20),clock_timestamp() after_at FROM a),b AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT z.* FROM pause CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(sum(p.calls),0) c,coalesce(sum(p.total_exec_time),0) t,coalesce(sum(p.wal_bytes),0) w,max(i.stats_reset) reset,max(i.dealloc) dealloc,clock_timestamp() at FROM pg_stat_statements p CROSS JOIN pg_stat_statements_info i WHERE p.toplevel AND clock_timestamp() >= pause.after_at) z) SELECT CASE WHEN a.reset=b.reset AND a.dealloc=b.dealloc AND b.c>=a.c AND b.t>=a.t AND b.w>=a.w AND b.at>a.at THEN ((b.t-a.t)/(extract(epoch FROM b.at-a.at)*1000))::float8 END AS cores,CASE WHEN a.reset=b.reset AND a.dealloc=b.dealloc AND b.c>=a.c AND b.t>=a.t AND b.w>=a.w AND b.at>a.at THEN ((b.w-a.w)/extract(epoch FROM b.at-a.at)/1e6)::float8 END AS wal_mb_s,(b.c-a.c)::float8 calls_in_window,extract(epoch FROM b.at-a.at)::float8 window_s,a.reset::text reset_before,b.reset::text reset_after,a.dealloc::text dealloc_before,b.dealloc::text dealloc_after FROM a CROSS JOIN b

WITH cohorts AS (SELECT tool_name,count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ok') success_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status<>'ok') non_success_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='error') error_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='timeout') timeout_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='refused') refused_n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='replayed') replay_n,NULL::int cancellation_n FROM harness_shared.tool_invocations WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND invoked_at>now()-interval '24 hours' AND tool_name IN ('coord:orient','scheduler:get_next','work_items:list','work_items:get','work_items:claim') GROUP BY tool_name) SELECT jsonb_agg(cohorts) outcomes,CASE WHEN count(*)=5 AND min(n)>=20 THEN max(100.0*non_success_n/n) END non_success_pct,'Cancellation-specific counts are unknown; status writer has no separate cancellation outcome. Non-ok attempts stay in the denominator.' cancellation_tracking FROM cohorts
